text: I am more open for new ideas and also for people from other cultures, before I was a bit closed. And I enjoy more the simple life, cooking with my family, walking in the park. I feel happier with my life in general, I think I appreciate more what I have.
Mir ist vieles egal geworden, was mich früher aufgeregt hat. Ich weiß nicht, ob das gut ist, manchmal fühle ich mich etwas gleichgültig.

Living with chronic pain had made me quite depressed, I felt my life was over at 35. The experience didn't take the pain away, but it took away a lot of the despair. I'm much less depressed now and I've found ways to enjoy life within my limits, like painting and gardening, which I can do even on bad days. I feel grateful for what my body can still do instead of only angry about what it can't. My psychiatrist reduced my antidepressants because I'm doing so much better.
More open minded, I listen more to other people's opinions now

Ich verstehe jetzt besser, woher mein Perfektionismus kommt, und kann ihn manchmal loslassen. Dadurch habe ich weniger Angst vor dem Scheitern und bin nicht mehr so schnell niedergeschlagen, wenn etwas nicht klappt. Ich hatte vorher immer wieder depressive Phasen nach schlechten Noten, das ist deutlich besser geworden. Ich gönne mir auch mehr Freizeit, ohne schlechtes Gewissen.

The experience improved my mental health in a way that I'm still discovering. The most immediate thing was a huge sense of love and connection. After the terrifying part was over, I spent hours lying in the grass with my friend holding my hand, and I felt so much love for him, for my family, for everyone I've ever known. I felt like we are all connected, and that love is the thing that holds it all together. That feeling didn't go away completely. It has softened, but it's like a warm light that I can come back to. I had been quite depressed and isolated before, mostly gaming and smoking weed alone in my room. After the experience I started reaching out to people again, I went to my family's for Sunday dinners, I joined a climbing gym. When my best friend died, I was devastated, but the love I felt for him and from our friends helped me through it. I'm not saying I'm always happy, but I feel alive, and I feel connected to people, and that's what matters most to me now.
I had a really nice afterglow for about 10 days, felt super positive and energetic. Then it was gone, and I'm basically back to normal. The cold water swimming I started helps my mood though.
Keine Veränderung meiner psychischen Gesundheit bemerkt.

It helped me finally get diagnosed with ADHD, which explains so much of my life. My self-esteem has improved a lot because I understand myself now. I'm on medication and I'm much less anxious and depressed than before, because I'm not constantly failing at things and blaming myself.

My mental health has improved a great deal. I had been depressed for years, mostly because of the exhaustion and grief around my son's disability. I felt like my life was just about surviving. The experience gave me back a sense of joy and gratitude. I felt so much love for my son, for my wife, for our strange little life together. I realised how much beauty there is in it, even in the hard parts. I laugh more now, and I notice the good moments, like when my son smiles at me in the morning or when my wife and I manage to have a quiet dinner. I still get exhausted, but the depression has lifted, and I feel like I'm living my life again instead of just enduring it. I'm also more grateful for the people who help us, the therapists, the nurses, our neighbours.
Ich bin dankbarer für mein Leben und genieße die Momente mehr. Ich habe auch das Gefühl, dass ich mehr Freude an meiner Arbeit und an meinen Hobbys habe.

I became a bit detached, honestly. Stuff in the news or drama with friends doesn't really touch me anymore. I'm calm but I'm not sure it's a good kind of calm, more like I've stopped caring about a lot of things.

I was close to burnout before the experience, I had trouble sleeping, I was crying in the car on my way to work, and I felt numb at home. After the experience, I started taking care of myself, and slowly my energy came back. I'm sleeping better, and I'm not dreading every shift. I'm also less irritable with my partner. I think the biggest change is that I see my own needs as important now.

Ich fühle mich offener und liebevoller, gegenüber mir selbst und anderen Menschen. Nach der Trennung hätte ich erwartet, dass ich in eine tiefe Krise falle, aber ich habe stattdessen viel Liebe gespürt, von meinen Freundinnen, meiner Familie und auch für mich selbst. Ich habe neue Menschen kennengelernt und mich auf neue Erfahrungen eingelassen, z.B. habe ich einen Kletterkurs angefangen und bin allein nach Portugal gereist. Ich bin offener für das, was das Leben bringt, und habe weniger Angst vor Veränderungen. Insgesamt würde ich sagen, dass es mir psychisch so gut geht wie lange nicht.
Feeling more alive and grateful

My BPD symptoms are less intense since the experience. I have fewer emotional crises and I don't self harm anymore. I feel more stable and I can regulate my emotions better, which also helps my relationships.

Ich habe durch die Erfahrung verstanden, warum ich mich in schwierigen Zeiten immer zurückziehe, und dass das mit meiner Kindheit zu tun hat. Meine Eltern haben viel gestritten, und ich habe gelernt, mich unsichtbar zu machen und alles mit mir selbst auszumachen. Dieses Verständnis hat mir geholfen, mich selbst nicht mehr so zu verurteilen. Ich bin freundlicher zu mir selbst und gehe offener auf andere zu. Außerdem bin ich dankbarer für die Menschen in meinem Leben. Ich habe gemerkt, wie viele gute Freunde ich eigentlich habe, und das macht mich glücklich. Meine Stimmung ist insgesamt besser und stabiler als vor der Erfahrung, und ich fühle mich weniger einsam.
Worse. I had anxiety and some derealization for a while after the experience, and I'm still more anxious than before, especially in crowds.
i feel so much love for everyone now its kinda crazy lol. my friends say im a hippie now

Ich bin dankbarer für die Zeit, die ich noch mit meinem Vater habe, und genieße unsere gemeinsamen Momente bewusster. Auch sonst sehe ich mehr das Schöne im Alltag, einen Spaziergang, ein gutes Gespräch, ein gemeinsames Essen.

My mental health has improved because I'm more open to life and to people. I used to be very sceptical and closed off, almost cynical. I didn't believe in anything except science and I was a bit arrogant about it. The experience opened my mind to the possibility that there is more to reality than what I can measure. I'm more curious now, and less judgemental of people who see things differently. I've also felt a lot more love and connection, which has made me happier and less lonely. I joined a meditation group, which I would have laughed at before.
I was in a great mood for a week or so, then it went back to normal.
Meine Zwangsgedanken sind deutlich weniger geworden. Ich kann sie besser vorbeiziehen lassen, ohne sofort darauf zu reagieren. Das gibt mir viel Lebensqualität zurück, und ich fühle mich freier.

I understand myself better now, especially my anger and where it comes from. I've stopped seeing myself as a broken person. I see myself as someone who went through some hard things and reacted the way anyone would. That has helped my mental health a lot. I'm less ashamed, and I'm more willing to get help. I've started seeing a counsellor at the VA.
I'm more open to other people's perspectives and I don't feel the need to argue so much. I'm curious about why people think what they think.
Auf meine psychische Gesundheit im engeren Sinne hatte die Erfahrung kaum Einfluss. Mir ging es vorher schon ganz gut.

The experience has helped my mental health enormously, especially since the cancer diagnosis. I think the most important thing it gave me is a profound appreciation for being alive. I came out of the experience feeling like everything is a gift: the sunlight, my children's voices, the taste of food, even the pain sometimes, because it means I'm still here. That appreciation has deepened since the diagnosis. Every day matters now. I also feel so much love, and I let myself receive love, which I wasn't good at before. My friends have organised meals and rides to the hospital, and instead of feeling like a burden, I feel grateful and loved. I've become much more open with my emotions. I cry when I'm sad, I laugh a lot, I tell people what they mean to me. I don't waste time on things that don't matter anymore. I'm not always positive, I have nights of fear, but I'm much more at peace than I ever thought I could be facing something like this. I feel like I'm truly living.
Grateful for my kids and my life, and generally in a better mood
Ich habe mich nach der Erfahrung ungefähr zwei Wochen lang richtig gut gefühlt, sehr entspannt und offen. Danach war es wieder wie vorher. Langfristig kann ich keinen großen Unterschied feststellen.

I feel a lot more love in my life, especially in my relationship. During the experience I had this overwhelming feeling of love for my girlfriend, and when I came back I realised how much I'd been taking her for granted. We're closer now, and I'm happier. I feel more secure and less anxious about the relationship, which used to be a big source of worry for me.
Mentally stronger, I'd say

Ich bin offener für neue Erfahrungen geworden und habe ein besseres Verständnis für mich selbst entwickelt. Ich weiß jetzt besser, was mir wichtig ist und was ich brauche, um mich wohl zu fühlen. Nach dem Umzug war ich anfangs einsam, aber ich bin aktiv auf Menschen zugegangen, was ich früher nie getan hätte. Inzwischen habe ich einen schönen neuen Freundeskreis.

I feel more detached from my emotions, kind of like an observer. Sometimes that's helpful, but sometimes I miss feeling things strongly. I'm not unhappy, just a bit distant from everything. Not sure if that's an improvement.

My OCD and anxiety have both improved a lot. I would say the experience opened a door, and then the therapy helped me walk through it. My compulsions take up maybe an hour a day now, compared to several hours before, and my anxiety is much more manageable. I also understand myself much better. I used to think my OCD was a character flaw, but now I see it as my brain trying to keep me safe in a world that felt very unsafe when I was a kid. That understanding has made me much kinder to myself. I have more energy for things I enjoy, and I've started dating again, which I hadn't done in years because I was so ashamed of my symptoms.
Ich bin dankbarer und zufriedener mit dem, was ich habe, und genieße die kleinen Dinge.

Since the experience, I feel a lot more love, for myself and for others. I'm happier and more content with my life. I appreciate the people around me more and I tell them. I used to be quite grumpy and negative, and now I'm the one who brings cake to the office on Fridays. Small things, but they make my days better, and I think other people notice too.

For a while it really hurt my mental health. I was anxious, couldn't sleep well and felt like something was wrong with my head. I went to see a doctor and she was helpful. It took about six months to feel normal again. Now I'm okay, but I'm not as carefree as I was before the experience, and I won't take psychedelics again.

Ich bin offener geworden, für andere Menschen, für neue Ideen und auch für meine eigenen Gefühle. Früher war ich sehr kopfgesteuert und habe Gefühle eher als lästig empfunden. Heute nehme ich sie ernster und kann sie auch zeigen. Ich bin dankbarer für mein Leben und für die Menschen um mich herum, vor allem für meine Kolleginnen, die mich so unterstützen. Ich freue mich mehr über Kleinigkeiten, z.B. wenn ein Kind im Kindergarten etwas Neues gelernt hat oder wenn ich nach der Arbeit im Garten sitze. Insgesamt bin ich psychisch stabiler und zufriedener als vor der Erfahrung.
I don't think it impacted my mental health much, I was already in a good place before.

I had moderate depression and anxiety for years and the experience was a turning point. It showed me how I had been neglecting myself, eating badly, not sleeping, not moving, isolating. I understood that my mood was connected to all of that. Since then I've built routines that support me, and my depression has improved a lot. I still have anxious periods, but they're shorter and I know what to do. I feel like I understand myself and my needs so much better.
